technicalReview.sourceSemantics: Each completed translation reviewed against English; unavailable, origin-server, elapsed timeout, excessive requests, unusual connections, optional JavaScript benefit and expected maintenance return distinguished.
technicalReview.limitations: Automated structural validation cannot certify idiomatic fluency. Lower-confidence drafts and full second-agent review remain explicit; no native-speaker certification claimed.
technicalReview.secondAgentReview: All26 files independently reviewed across all50 unique source groups and repeated occurrences. Cyrillic Montenegrin additionally checked against its reviewed Latin counterpart.
reviewCorrections: sl: unsecured request wording sharpened for TLS context
ka/ky/tt: unusual connection count is neutral rather than necessarily excessive
la: explicit reflexive object in HTTP connection clause
